skills.name: Attack
skills.description: Increases base Click Damage in Story Mode.

skills.name: Magic
skills.description: Increases base Auto-DPS and unlocks magic skills.

skills.name: Lore
skills.description: Reduces story duration gate and increases Essence.

skills.name: Precision
skills.description: Increases critical hit chance and multiplier.

skills.name: Auto-Strike
skills.description: Automatically attacks enemies for base DPS each second. Each level adds +5 DPS/s. Contributes to Story Mode auto-attack alongside all other auto_dps_base skills.

skills.name: Clickstorm
skills.description: Automatically clicks at 10 CPS for 30 seconds.

skills.name: Golden Clicks
skills.description: Each click earns 5% of the current monster's gold value directly.

skills.name: The Dark Ritual
skills.description: Applies a +1.05x DPS multiplier that persists for the entire current Chapter. Resets on new Chapter.

skills.name: Energize
skills.description: The next skill activated deals double its stated effect.

skills.name: Reload
skills.description: Reduces the cooldown of the last used skill by 50%.
